categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Rimag Group operates three primary business segments: (1) Imaging Center Services, which include flagship, regional collaborative, specialized medical consortium, and operational management imaging centers; (2) Imaging Solution Services, offering equipment selection, configuration, maintenance, and infrastructure renovation; and (3) Rimag Cloud Services, providing cloud-based medical imaging workflow and operational management solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital technologies, including AI-driven medical imaging analysis, a proprietary cloud platform (Rimag Cloud), and a large-scale, standardized medical imaging database. It utilizes modular, data-driven service delivery, standardized imaging protocols, and collaborates on AI foundation models for full-modal, full-process medical imaging applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are hospitals (public and private), health management companies, and other medical institutions, as well as individual patients and healthcare consumers. The company serves both large-scale public medical systems and internet hospitals, with a growing focus on overseas healthcare providers in regions with underdeveloped medical infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Mainland China, with a network covering 16 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities, operating 106 imaging centers as of end-2024. It has begun expanding internationally, with business activities in Hong Kong, Macao, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Rimag Group operates primarily at the midstream and downstream points of the medical imaging supply chain, acting as a service integrator, operator, and manager of imaging centers, as well as a provider of imaging solutions and cloud-based services. It also collaborates with upstream equipment manufacturers and supply chain service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the imaging center network, deepening AI and big data integration in medical imaging, developing comprehensive smart imaging solutions, and internationalizing the business. R&D focuses on AI foundation models, data standardization, cloud platform enhancements, and collaborative innovation with industry leaders such as Huawei Cloud and iFlytek.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through a mix of service fees for imaging examinations and diagnostics, operational management contracts, sales and maintenance of imaging equipment, infrastructure renovation, cloud platform subscriptions, and software sales. Revenue is recognized both at point of service delivery and over time for ongoing management and cloud services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangxi Rimag Group positions itself as the leading third-party medical imaging services provider in China and is the first listed company in this segment. It faces competition from other imaging service providers, equipment manufacturers, and emerging AI healthcare companies, but differentiates itself through its scale, integrated ecosystem, and data-driven AI capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 760.6 million, a decrease of 18.1% year-on-year due to macroeconomic and regulatory headwinds, with a net loss of RMB 58.9 million. Despite a temporary downturn, the company maintains a large asset base (RMB 2.26 billion), strong equity, and expects a return to stable growth as industry demand recovers and new centers come online.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi Rimag Group offers a unique value proposition by integrating physical imaging center networks with advanced AI and big data capabilities, enabling standardized, high-quality, and accessible medical imaging services. Its closed-loop ecosystem, proprietary data assets, and AI-driven diagnostic tools provide differentiated, scalable solutions for both domestic and international healthcare markets.
